_source: Re-based onto environment/nanogpt_substrate.json for batch OER-2026-08-20. solution/grounding.yaml and solution/recompute.py still describe the retired statistics surrogate and must be re-derived against these bytes before this slot is frozen.
_state_note: A previous revision of this slot published 12.75 here as a frozen scalar. That number described a JSON statistics stand-in rather than a model, and it is retired rather than carried across. Publishing a stated perplexity on this surface would be publishing half the graded quantity.
frozen: the model, being the nanoGPT checkpoint of the architecture declared at environment/nanogpt_substrate.json
the bit budget, being environment/substrate.json budget_bits
the evaluation corpus, being the held-out FineWeb validation folds the verifier owns
the unquantized reference, being that same checkpoint evaluated unquantized
reference_artifact: the pristine nanoGPT checkpoint, verifier-owned copy
statement: The unquantized reference in this slot IS the nanoGPT checkpoint at environment/substrate.json checkpoint.path, evaluated unquantized. It is not a number written down in this file. The reference perplexity is MEASURED by the verifier in run, by a real forward pass of the pristine checkpoint over the same held-out FineWeb folds your quantized parameters are read on, so the two halves of the degradation are produced by one code path on one corpus and cannot drift apart.
